{
  "pattern_id": "P-LIT-PRIORITIZE",
  "decision": "APPLY",
  "rationale": "The pattern P-LIT-PRIORITIZE suggests reordering tests to provide earlier failure feedback. In a Go environment, running 'go test -short' or specific high-value packages first can achieve this. However, since the exact failure-prone tests are unknown without historical data, a common prioritization strategy is to run tests with the '-race' flag or specific sub-packages. Since I must preserve all original commands and cannot determine the best test order without history, I will implement a minimal change that separates the test execution into two stages: a fast/short test run followed by the full test suite. This follows the 'Rank tests' mechanism by attempting to surface failures earlier in the pipeline. I will also add caching for Go dependencies to ensure the baseline performance is not degraded by the split.",
  "workflow_yaml": "name: CI Test

on:
  push:
  pull_request:
  workflow_dispatch:

jobs:
  ci-test:
    runs-on: ubuntu-22.04
    if: "!contains(github.event.head_commit.message, '[ci skip]') && !contains(github.event.head_commit.message, '[skip ci]')"
    strategy:
      matrix:
        go-version: ['1.22', '1.24', '1.26']

    steps:
      - name: Checkout
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Install Go ${{ matrix.go-version }}
        uses: actions/setup-go@v5
        with:
          go-version: ${{ matrix.go-version }}
          check-latest: true
          cache: true

      - run: gofmt -w -s . && git diff --exit-code --color

      - run: go install -v ./...

      - name: Prioritized Test Run (Short)
        run: go test -v -short ./...

      - name: Full Test Run
        run: go test -v ./...

      - run: go vet ./...

      - name: apt install needed Debian packages
        run: |
          sudo eatmydata apt update
          sudo eatmydata apt install git-buildpackage pristine-tar pandoc

      - name: Generate man page from Markdown
        run: pandoc -f markdown -t man -s dh-make-golang.md -o dh-make-golang.1

      - name: dh-make-golang test run for "gh"
        run: |
          git config --global user.email "dh-make-golang@debian.org"
          git config --global user.name "dh-make-golang on GitHub"
          mkdir -p _test-run
          cd _test-run
          ~/go/bin/dh-make-golang -type p -pristine-tar -program_package_name gh github.com/cli/cli

      - name: Upload dh-make-golang test run as artifact
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: dh-make-golang_test-run_go${{ matrix.go-version }}
          path: _test-run
"
}
